cost.basis: sum of Harbor recorded cost_usd over selected trials

recalculated.basis: recalculated from the Grok CLI's per-call usage with reasoning tokens priced as output, at LiteLLM's xai/grok-4.7 rates as Harbor prices them
recalculated.note: Cost on the subset is our recalculation, not Harbor's recorded cost. Harbor's grok-build adapter counted only the Grok CLI's visible output tokens and left out the reasoning tokens the CLI reports separately (about 80% of all output here), so the Hub's output tokens and cost omit reasoning (harbor-framework/harbor#3805). We repriced each of the 95 subset trials from the CLI's per-call usage in the trial's public Hub log, the way Harbor prices it (LiteLLM's xai/grok-4.7 rates, long-context rates from 200k prompt tokens), with reasoning counted as output: $632.73 against $530.86 recorded (+19%). Our fast-agent runs record xAI's own output count, which includes reasoning. The full run's published total ($3,683.29) is Harbor's and omits reasoning the same way.

tokens.basis: Harbor per-trial input_tokens (includes cached), cache_tokens, output_tokens

scan.scope: the row's 95 trials on the 19-task subset (subset.json)

top.title: Verifier test or solution path accessed
